title: Porta a Porta activists demonstrate in Beja for housing

tea.why: High housing costs, low wages, and increasing difficulties in accessing and maintaining affordable housing.
tea.want: Lower house prices and rents, reduced interest rates, contract stability, and more public housing.
tea.changed: Nov 13: Movimento Porta a Porta announced a demonstration in Beja as part of nationwide actions.

summary: Activists from the Movimento Porta a Porta have organised a demonstration in Beja as part of nationwide actions across multiple cities to demand affordable housing. The protest is scheduled to begin at the Casa da Cultura. According to the organisers, low wages and high housing costs have made rents and mortgage payments unaffordable for many, while government proposals regarding evictions and budget allocations for housing are rejected. The movement's demands include rent regulation, lower interest rates, secure rental contracts, an end to evictions without alternative housing, and increased public and student housing.
demands: End to evictions without alternative housing
Reinforcement of public and student housing
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Movimento Porta a Porta announced a demonstration in Beja for Saturday as part of nationwide actions.
Organisers highlighted housing difficulties and demanded lower rents, mortgage relief, and more public housing.
